verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation or claims about real-time/live UI updates or WebSocket-based sync that would let a teammate's change appear instantly in another open Asana session without refreshing; only webhooks for external app notification (asana-docs-31) and API/integration material are present, which don't address in-app live collaboration. Community comments even flag performance/frontend issues (asana-comm-7, asana-comm-8), but nothing concretely confirms or denies instant cross-session updates, so absence of evidence for this applicable axis yields 'none'.
